quote: You build walls to keep the sorrow out. But loneliness lives quietly inside those heavy stones. You pretend the silence doesn't hurt your soul. Every night you replay words you never spoke aloud. The world thinks you are standing completely strong. But you are barely holding the pieces together. Someday you will finally learn how to let go.
